title: Tensor pullback of commutative algebra sheaves on algebraic spaces
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $f:X\to Y$ be a morphism of algebraic spaces with their small etale sites [def-trf-algebraic-space], in the universes of [def-weil-size-convention]. Use the categories of commutative algebra sheaves and their underlying-module functors $U_X,U_Y$ [def-sfb-space-comm-algebra-sheaf], and the specified module tensor pullback $f^*$ and local tensor sections [def-trf-space-etale-module-functors]. An algebra tensor pullback model is a functor $F:\operatorname{CAlg}(\mathcal O_Y)\to\operatorname{CAlg}(\mathcal O_X)$ with a natural isomorphism $e:U_XF\simeq f^*U_Y$, such that the local tensors transported by $e^{-1}$ satisfy $1\otimes1=1$ and $(b\otimes a)(c\otimes d)=bc\otimes ad$, on every chart $q=(T\to X,T\to V)$ over an etale scheme $V\to Y$. Such a model exists and for any two models $D,E$ there is a unique natural algebra isomorphism $\alpha:D.F\simeq E.F$ with $E.e\circ U_X\alpha=D.e$. The canonical algebra tensor pullback model is chosen through this normalized uniqueness property; its underlying module pullback and its multiplication are not arbitrary.
